item.title: H.S. BASKETBALL: Blue Mountain extends winning streak to four with 64-47 win over Pine Grove
item.description: The Blue Mountain Eagles boys’ basketball team continues to be one of the Schuylkill League’s top programs since the turn of the calendar. On Friday night, the Eagles earned their fourth straight victory and ninth in their last 11 games with a 64-47 win over the Pine Grove Area Cardinals in Pine Grove.
